RSS Feed Add to Google Follow on Google News EARNINGS & GUIDANCE The Home Depot (HD) reported Q1 fiscal 2026 results and reaffirmed full‑year guidance, providing a steady read on consumer home‑spend and inventory management for retailers and suppliers. Bilibili (BILI) published Q1 2026 results; user growth and monetization remain key to China‑tech sentiment amid regulatory scrutiny. GitLab (GTLB) set a date to announce first‑quarter fiscal 2027 results, a datapoint investors watch for ARR and gross‑margin progress. CAVA Group (CAVA) released Q1 results, where sales and margin trends offer a snapshot of consumer dining and off‑premise demand. Toll Brothers (TOL) posted FY26 Q2 results; backlog and order cadence remain the main housing indicators to watch. James Hardie (JHX) reported Q4 FY26 and full‑year results with FY27 outlook, useful for gauging pricing power in building materials. BIG TECH, AI & INFRASTRUCTURE Apple (AAPL) rolled out new accessibility features tied to Apple Intelligence; the announcement underscores how AI is being embedded across hardware and services to boost engagement and recurring revenue. Dell Technologies (DELL) unveiled PowerStore Elite, aiming to reshape enterprise storage economics for AI and mixed workloads. Analog Devices (ADI) agreed to acquire Empower Semiconductor, strengthening power‑management capabilities that matter for data‑center and AI accelerator designs. Keysight Technologies (KEYS) posted Q2 2026 results, a demand signal for semiconductor test tied to AI chip scaling and 5G rollouts. NextNav (NN) demonstrated a wireless indoor timing solution for critical infrastructure—timing indoors has implications for telecom, utilities and 5G resiliency. AEye (LIDR) signed an MOU with MoveAWheeL to combine long‑range lidar and real‑time road‑surface friction sensing, a commercial step for safety systems in vehicles and ADAS suppliers. HEALTHCARE & BIOTECH Hansa Biopharma (HNSA) struck a €115M licensing deal for IDEFIRIX in Europe and MENA, de‑risking regional commercial exposure and cash flow visibility. Valion Bio (VBIO) briefed senior Department of War and BARDA officials on entolimod for acute radiation syndrome in a joint engagement; involvement of BARDA/DoD can accelerate development and support funding pathways for biodefense candidates. Monopar (MNPR) announced publication of a Phase 2 study showing ALXN1840 significantly improves copper balance in Wilson disease—data that can affect regulatory and partnering prospects. IGC Pharma (IGC) reported Q1 2026 results and said CALMA Phase 2 is ~80% enrolled, a progress update investors track for milestone timing. Relay Therapeutics (RLAY) filed for a proposed stock offering after early Zovegalisib data; dilution versus program upside will be weighed by investors. Eton Pharmaceuticals (ETON) expanded its rare‑disease portfolio with U.S. rights to IMPAVIDO® (miltefosine), bolstering specialty sales potential. Details. DEFENSE, AEROSPACE & INDUSTRIALS Boeing (BA) drew scrutiny over reliance on Chinese rare‑earth magnets for U.S. military drone production, a reminder that geopolitics reshape defense supply chains and reshoring discussions. GE Aerospace (GE) won a U.S. Air Force contract to advance the GE426 engine for an autonomous collaborative platform, supporting long‑cycle aerospace revenue visibility. ENERGY, CLEAN TECH & MATERIALS Anaergia (AMRC) secured a C$58M contract with Neogenyx Fuels to expand RNG deployment, strengthening backlog and multiyear revenue visibility in decarbonization infrastructure. Contract. Shoals Technologies Group (SHLS) opened a new Tennessee mega‑facility to support U.S. manufacturing of solar balance‑of‑system components, easing supply constraints for project developers. Celanese (CE) announced an engineered‑materials price increase, an input to margin modeling across downstream industrials and auto suppliers. M&A, CAPITAL MARKETS & CORPORATE ACTIONS AIG (EG) agreed to acquire Everest’s insurance operations in Colombia, expanding Latin America underwriting reach. Details. B
